title: Braised Croatian Cabbage
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the flavors of Croatia with the simplicity of braised cabbage.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the bacon bits and cook until crispy.
Remove the bacon and set aside.
Add the shredded cabbage to the pot and cook until slightly tender.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the bacon to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the cabbage is tender.
